title: WO EmDash drops the generic model; read and write errors are not handed off early
steps: Run WO with and without posts with a model configured; run an ordinary site; trigger identity, source, report and CMS write errors.
Call the real create door with a held WO build and check the link right after the brief engine starts.
expect: WO loads no model and does no warm-up; the tool gets --no-model --no-images and no key; an ordinary site keeps warm-up/replay.
Identity/source errors create no credential file; a timeout, a broken report or a write error stops the fill; missing copy without a write error may be handed to the agent.
site_creation and wo_build are linked before prepare, even without a create receipt/page plan/items.
fence: Identity from the DB before the model, strict reads, receipts written before handoff.

tests: WO without posts skips warm-up and all generic model configuration
WO with posts skips warm-up and all generic model configuration
an ordinary site retains model warm-up, replay and image configuration
an unreadable WO identity fails before models, tools or temporary credential files
WO sourceError cannot be mistaken for missing source content
WO copyError cannot be mistaken for missing source content
WO copy skipped without a write error can continue to the agent
WO sourced posts refused by the site fail the fill instead of continuing to handoff
WO sourced slot writes refused by the site fail the fill instead of continuing to handoff
WO setup refuses incomplete tool work:
WO identity exists before its create receipt, even without a page plan or sourced posts
WO identity and strict source readers reject database errors instead of reporting an ordinary or empty site
the create door commits WO identity before starting the brief engine
